name: Kate Zammit
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: As a Gestalt Psychotherapist, I feel genuinely grateful to do work that I love and feel both humbled and honoured to sit with people during some of their most vulnerable and authentic moments. My psychotherapy practice in Carlton and Essendon is informed not only by my professional training but also by my own lived experience of a personal therapeutic journey. I understand what it’s like to sit on the other side of the room, and I have a deep appreciation for how difficult it can feel at times.

name: Sally Cooper
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
practice: Sally Cooper Consulting Group Pty Ltd
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.

name: Dee Henry
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Dee is a registered counsellor, she has many years of experience working with marginalised groups in the human rights and community sector. Dee provides individual counselling to adolescents and adults, relationship counselling and family counselling. She is passionate about supporting people through experiences with anxiety, depression, trauma, life transitions and relationship issues.

name: Jessica Ruschen
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am passionate about empowering people to prosper in life. I pride myself on building secure, comfortable connections with my clients, as I have seen over and over that a strong therapeutic relationship is the precursor to lasting growth. I have a strengths based approach to therapy that is grounded in evidence-based practices, including Acceptance & Commitment Therapy (ACT), Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), Schema Therapy, Solution Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT) and mindfulness-based interventions.

name: Charlene Ma
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Are you feeling overwhelmed by anxiety, sadness, or self-doubt, even when you're trying your best to keep things together? Perhaps you feel a deep sense that something is out of balance, and you're longing for inner peace and more fulfilling relationships. My approach is relational, trauma-informed, and tailored uniquely to your needs.

name: Rhiannon Gill
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: At Express Yourself Counselling, we provide a safe space for you to express your feelings and thoughts. We specialise in working with children and adults, to help positively promote their mental health and wellbeing. We are located in Parkdale, and our compassionate team is here to support you through life's challenges with understanding and empathy.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Debra Battersby
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Hello, thanks for visiting. My name is Debra and Heart Life Counselling is a counselling service for adults (16+), individual and couples, that also has a special interest in supporting recovery from trauma & abuse. Over the years I have pursued a particular interest and expertise in anxiety and trauma work, depression, anxiety, recovery from past abuse, and relationship stresses including recovery from domestic violence.

name: Ange Bishop
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: As a registered psychotherapist and counsellor, I help people make sense of their thoughts, feelings, and the world around them to bring improvements to their psychological wellbeing. Whatever brings you to therapy, I will meet you with openness, honesty and respect. I currently see clients from a private practice in South Yarra, and online, providing a confidential, non-judgemental space.
